purpose: Read-only inspect of the official Python downloads HTML as seen by the independent urllib verifier.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,re,urllib.request
from html.parser import HTMLParser
class P(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.parts=[]
 def handle_data(self,d):
  if d and d.strip(): self.parts.append(d.strip())
req=urllib.request.Request('https://www.python.org/downloads/',headers={'User-Agent':'ProjectBrain-IndependentVerifier/1'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:
 raw=r.read(2000000); final=r.geturl(); headers=dict(r.headers.items())
html=raw.decode('utf-8','replace')
p=P(); p.feed(html); text=' '.join(p.parts)
out={
 'final_url':final,
 'content_type':headers.get('Content-Type'),
 'content_encoding':headers.get('Content-Encoding'),
 'raw_bytes':len(raw),
 'has_release_marker':'Python releases by version number' in text,
 'has_3147':'3.14.7' in text,
 'semvers':re.findall(r'3\.\d+\.\d+',text)[:30],
 'text_excerpt':text[:8000],
 'raw_excerpt':html[:4000]
}
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
print('PYTHON_HTTP_DIAG_COMPLETE')
PY
